name: cuButterfly external comparison catalog
precision_evidence_scope: precision_support.local_measured lists only precision cohorts verified for this catalog update; empty lists mean not_verified_in_this_update, not proof that no historical measurement exists. Bind exact campaign/raw records before aggregating results.
comparison_rules: direct baselines require matching operator, precision, direction, normalization, placement, layout and timing scope
processing-unit entries are measured only inside a cuButterfly composition and are not whole-library baselines
source-only and end-to-end entries provide method context until a matching local adapter exists
published or upstream performance numbers are never copied into local result aggregates
cooperative xD candidates are a finite, resource-gated local inventory and are not a complete cross-axis pipeline or global-optimality claim

FFT-H requires FP32/FP64 input storage and core arithmetic; FFT-L includes FP16/BF16 inputs and explicit low-precision multiplication with high-precision accumulation; retain storage/compute/accumulation separately
TF32 multiplication would belong to FFT-L but has no supported local manifest execution contract; never count it as FP32 arithmetic

precision_support.provider records bounded upstream capability domains while local_measured records precision cohorts only; every comparison still requires exact campaign provenance and matching semantics

precision_support.local_adapter: scripts/run_semantic_campaign.py:baseline_contract and scripts/semantic_fft_baseline.py accept only complex FP32/FP64; NativeCufft binds cufftExecC2C/Z2Z, not cufftXt low precision
precision_support.constraints: FP16/BF16 provider support is hardware-, size-, layout- and API-dependent; provider support is not local measurement evidence

entries.name: NVIDIA cuFFT
entries.scope: complete GPU FFT library with 1D/2D/3D, batches, strides and compact real transforms

precision_support.local_adapter: scripts/vkfft_xd.py:NativeVkfft accepts only complex64/complex128 and forwards an fp64 boolean; no half/BF16 mode is bound
precision_support.constraints: Upstream half support does not imply BF16 support or a locally measured low-precision path; exact pinned provider contracts are campaign-specific

entries.name: VkFFT
entries.scope: cross-platform complete GPU FFT library; pinned versions and exact contracts are recorded per campaign

entries.name: Dao-AILab fast-hadamard-transform
entries.scope: CUDA/PyTorch FWHT for supported FP16/BF16/FP32 shapes

entries.name: GPU-NTT
entries.scope: fixed-prime NTT contracts; natural and bit-reversed output are separate cases

precision_support.constraints: A local processing core inside cuButterfly organization; provider precision support does not change this role

entries.name: NVIDIA cuFFTDx
entries.scope: device-side thread/block FFT core imported into a cuButterfly mapping

precision_support.constraints: FP32 local processing-core cohort; other provider precision domains are unknown in this update and are not classified as measured

entries.name: TurboFFT
entries.scope: generated architecture-aware FFT kernels; local-core and complete-library roles remain separate

precision_support.constraints: Upstream half Tensor Core implementation; local adapter CPU-compiled for SM80, GPU execution and CUDA Graph behavior unverified

entries.name: tcFFT

local_build.validation: CPU compilation and contract tests only; no GPU availability, correctness, performance or Graph validation claim

entries.scope: Prepared rank-1 forward unnormalized C2C FP16 storage/multiply/WMMA accumulation adapter with explicit reorder/copy; exact length, batch-divisibility and grid limits checked by scripts/tcfft_baseline.py:support; GPU validation pending

entries.name: FFTX/SpectralPack
entries.scope: symbolic transform composition, code generation and fused data movement

precision_support.constraints: CPU FFT cohort; excluded from GPU speedup aggregates

entries.name: FFTW
entries.scope: CPU C2C FP32/FP64 rank1-8 packed natural requests, FFTW_MEASURE, 1/8 threads; required scaling included; cross-platform results kept separate from GPU speedup aggregates

entries.name: FXT
entries.scope: Original single-thread FXT cores: FP32/FP64 Walsh-Hadamard, uint32/uint64 arithmetic and reversed arithmetic transforms; inverse, copy and normalization adapters timed; xD flattening uses the tensor-product identity

entries.name: Intel HEXL
entries.scope: Pinned external uint64 CPU NTT with timed cyclic/root/order and per-axis adapters; uint32 requests explicitly report exact storage widening and narrowing, never native word32; host ISA recorded

entries.name: HazyResearch butterfly author CPU implementation
entries.scope: Unmodified author CPU core for matching broadcast 2x2 FP32/FP64 stages, per-axis packing and complete output cost included; author baseline, not a claim of fastest CPU implementation

entries.name: SPIRAL
entries.scope: symbolic transform search and generated implementations; no matching local GPU contract

precision_support.constraints: FP16/BF16 input FFT convolution end-to-end library; internal accumulation does not make it an FFT-H or a complete raw FFT baseline

entries.name: FlashFFTConv
entries.scope: fused long convolution with factorized FFT; not a raw C2C FFT baseline

entries.name: GPU-NTT Merge/Four-Step paper
entries.scope: NTT-specific factorization, shared-memory reuse and stage organization

entries.name: HadaCore
entries.scope: Tensor-Core Hadamard processing unit; no matching local adapter is installed

entries.name: TensorIR
entries.scope: separation of local compute blocks, outer mapping and tensorization

entries.name: TVM
entries.scope: tensor compiler and scheduling separation; no butterfly-specific local-core adapter

entries.name: Ansor
entries.scope: hierarchical sketch generation, evolutionary search and learned cost models

entries.name: ROLLER
entries.scope: hardware-aware tile construction and micro-performance modeling

entries.name: Welder
entries.scope: tile graph, storage-level connecting, traffic and footprint modeling

entries.name: Timeloop
entries.scope: separate workload, architecture and mapping spaces for hierarchical dataflow analysis

entries.name: QuIP#
entries.scope: randomized Hadamard transforms in low-bit LLM quantization; application context rather than a raw FWHT baseline

entries.name: Triton
entries.scope: tiled GPU program generation; no native cross-CTA butterfly stage contract
